description: This Java source file defines the 'PackageSummary' class, an Android activity that displays detailed information about a specific installed package, such as its components, version, source directories, and status flags. It constructs a UI dynamically based on package info, enabling users to view and restart the package's process.

classes.name: PackageSummary
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed information about an installed package, including components and status flags.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves package info, and populates the UI with package details.

methods.name: setItemText
methods.description: Sets the text of a button to the simple class name from a fully qualified class name.

methods.name: ActivityOnClick
methods.description: An inner class that handles clicks on component buttons to launch a details view.
